name: ODRL Rule
abstract: W3C ODRL 2.2 Rule: Permission (with duties), Prohibition (with remedies) or Duty (with consequences). Each rule has one action and may name its target asset or asset collection, output, assigner, assignee and constraints; target and parties may instead be given at policy level. Uses building blocks: odrlAction, odrlAsset, odrlParty, odrlConstraint (odrlProperties), objectReference (cdifDataType).
